title: Career Compass Interest Quiz
description: Answer a few questions to discover career areas that may match your interests, strengths, and preferred working style.
disclaimer: This quiz provides general career guidance only. It is not a professional psychological or career assessment.

Technology.description: You may enjoy solving digital problems, understanding systems, and creating useful technology.

Medicine.description: You may enjoy supporting people's wellbeing, studying science, and making careful decisions that help others.

Law.description: You may enjoy analysing information, defending ideas, resolving disagreements, and promoting fairness.

Business.description: You may enjoy planning, leading projects, identifying opportunities, and developing practical business ideas.

Engineering.description: You may enjoy mathematics, practical problem-solving, designing systems, and understanding how things work.

Creative Arts.description: You may enjoy visual communication, storytelling, original ideas, and expressing messages creatively.

Education.description: You may enjoy explaining ideas, supporting people's development, mentoring others, and encouraging learning.

Finance.description: You may enjoy working with numbers, evaluating information, managing resources, and making evidence-based decisions.

Agriculture.description: You may enjoy nature, food production, practical fieldwork, sustainability, and community development.
